assertion: Supplementation with 21 g/d of poorly digested soluble fibers (polydextrose or soluble corn fiber) for 21 days shifted the fecal Bacteroidetes:Firmicutes ratio in healthy men (n=21, crossover RCT). Firmicutes decreased from 68% (no-fiber control) to 56% (polydextrose) and 55% (SCF) (P<0.001). Bacteroidetes increased from 25% to 36% and 38% respectively (P<0.001). The B:F ratio correlated positively with total dietary fiber intake (r=0.45, P=0.003) but NOT with BMI (r=0.06, P=0.64). Parabacteroides was the primary driver, increasing 4-5× (1.66%→6.83% PDX, 7.94% SCF, P<0.001). However, known butyrate producers Eubacterium (11.2%→6.31% PDX, 5.94% SCF), Dorea (1.32%→0.81% PDX, 0.82% SCF), and Roseburia (3.80%→2.33% PDX, 2.40% SCF) all DECREASED with fiber (P<0.001). Butanoate metabolism genes were depleted 15-20% (P=0.001, q=0.004). Amino acid metabolism genes showed the largest functional enrichment after fiber (P<0.0001).

subject.name: soluble fiber (polydextrose and soluble corn fiber)

object.name: Bacteroidetes:Firmicutes ratio shift with butyrate producer depletion

qualifiers.conditions: Double-blind, placebo-controlled, 3-period crossover; 21 g/d supplemental fiber; 21 days per period; whole-genome shotgun 454 pyrosequencing; KEGG functional annotation

provenance.ref: Holscher HD, Caporaso JG, Hooda S, Brulc JM, Fahey GC, Swanson KS. Fiber supplementation influences phylogenetic structure and functional capacity of the human intestinal microbiome. Am J Clin Nutr 2015;101:55-64
provenance.original_text: The abundance of the Firmicutes phylum was lower (P < 0.001) when men consumed polydextrose (56%) and SCF (55%) than when they consumed NFC (68%)... Within carbohydrate metabolism, butanoate metabolism was depleted 15% and 20% with polydextrose and SCF.

corroboration_refs: Boler et al. 2011 — same RCT, 16S amplicon: similar taxonomic shifts
integrity.coi_detail: JMB (co-author) is an employee of General Mills Inc. Study supported in part by General Mills. However, the finding that butyrate producers DECREASED argues against a purely promotional narrative.
integrity.methodology_note: Well-designed crossover RCT. n=21 modest but crossover design increases power. The PARADOX of butyrate producer depletion despite prebiotic fiber is the most important finding.

chain_hints: PARADOX: Fiber supplementation DEPLETED butyrate producers (Eubacterium, Roseburia, Dorea) and butanoate metabolism genes. This contradicts simple 'fiber feeds good bacteria' narratives.
Connects to BIO-026 (P. dorei in psyllium nonresponders) — same genus responding to fiber
Connects to NUT-017 (low-FODMAP → Bifidobacterium reduction) — fiber effects on microbiome are not uniformly beneficial
For Irene: fiber supplementation has complex, not uniformly positive, effects. 'Eat more fiber' is oversimplified.
The amino acid metabolism enrichment may connect to MECH-022 (protein fermentation → H2S)
